data.summary: All figures match what I recall from Apple's FY2022 10-K (not checked against the filing): revenue $394.3B vs $365.8B (+7.8%), net income $99.8B vs $94.7B (+5.4%), operating cash flow $122.2B vs $104.0B, total assets $352.8B vs $351.0B, total liabilities $302.1B vs $287.9B, cash $23.6B vs $34.9B. The 'margin pressure' point is fair but small: net margin went from about 25.9% to 25.3% while gross margin rose. The cash decline mostly reflects buybacks and dividends.
